items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Dave was teaching me at that time

ctx.x: Where'd you get your first trombone?

My first trombone? I bought that trombone from a man that used to play in the Shrine Band. And he told me, Dave was teaching me at that time, and I told him I wanted to buy one so I could have it to practice at home. And he saw this man that played in the Shrine Band and he bought it from me. And I only paid $40 for it. And I kept that trombone, oh I guess about eight years or nine years.
